name: Almanac
author: harbefas
description: Calendar, agenda and event manager backed by khal.

barWidget.description: Calendar, agenda and event manager backed by khal.

schema.label: Bar label format
schema.description: Qt date format. Right-clicking the widget walks the presets and writes the result back here.

schema.label: Alternate bar label
schema.description: Second format kept in the right-click ring.

schema.label: Vertical bar label
schema.description: Used when the bar runs down the side of the screen.

schema.label: Week starts on
schema.description: Locale follows the rest of the desktop. Clicking the grid's W heading also changes this.

schema.label: Calendar for new events
schema.description: Must be a writable calendar in khal's config. Empty picks the first writable one.

schema.label: Birth year
schema.description: Optional. With a life expectancy, the popup draws a second progress bar. 0 hides it.

schema.label: Life expectancy
schema.description: Optional, in years. 0 hides the bar.
